Name: Softer Cuter Dog Sounds
Author: cocacola1018
Description:
Do you want the pet dog's sound effects to sound more like a dog from a smaller or quieter breed? Are the standard dog sound effects too loud and jarring for you?

This mod replaces the standard barking and panting effects with a smaller dog's barking and snorting. Or whatever you call those grunty dog noises. The effects are recorded from my own irl dog, who is a very quiet Boston Terrier.

As of 1.1.0, this mod is configurable! Choose up to 2 of the 3 sounds I've recorded (a muffled bark, a snort, or a sneezy snuffle). You can also replace either or both of the dog audio clips with silence. I've noticed some mods that change pet behavior can lead to one of the effects being played a bunch of times in quick succession, so if this affects you, you can silence the annoying effect without completely muting your dog. Yes, GMCM is supported!

I was motivated to make this mod in part because the default sounds bother my misophonia. In my opinion, these sound effects are much more friendly to people with sensory issues. If you have any suggestions, please let me know!

PS because people are saying very nice things about my pup: His name is Domino, he's a little old man now (13ish) but he's going strong! If he knew I made a mod of his noises, and that people like it, it would inflate his ego very much. 1 endorse = pets and brushes for the good boi (I mean I'll pet him anyway but this time it'll be on your behalf haha)
